description: Recorded RP-02 provenance for the pinned Rack 2.6.6 SDK. Regenerate sections with bin/rack-sdk closure --write and survey --write; verify with bin/rack-sdk verify/closure/survey.

preliminary_survey.note: Preliminary RP-02 navigation data. Not an inventory or coverage count; RP-05 supersedes it.

tree_digest_definition: sha256 of `<sha256>  <path>\n` lines for every file under the directory, sorted by path bytes, paths relative to Rack-SDK/, excluding .DS_Store; equals `find DIR -type f ! -name .DS_Store | LC_ALL=C sort | xargs sha256sum | sha256sum`.
